_comment: adcert campaign config. 'reviewers' maps group -> reviewer sam; members of unmapped groups route to their own AD manager attribute. '_escalation' receives entries where the mapped reviewer would be certifying their own access. 'plain_language' descriptions appear on every review row — write them for the supervisor, not the sysadmin.
